zadanie: What is the remainder when $2^3 \cdot 4^5 \cdot 6^7 \cdot 8^9$ is divided by 13?
oczekiwana_odpowiedz: The prime factorization of $2^3 \cdot 4^5 \cdot 6^7 \cdot 8^9$ is $2^{47} \cdot 3^7$.  We see that $2^6 \equiv 64 \equiv -1 \pmod{13}$, so \[2^{47} \equiv 2^{6 \cdot 7 + 5} \equiv (2^6)^7 \cdot 2^5 \equiv (-1)^7 \cdot 32 \equiv -32 \equiv 7 \pmod{13},\]and $3^7 \equiv 2187 \equiv 3 \pmod{13}$, so $2^{47} \cdot 3^7 \equiv 7 \cdot 3 \equiv 21 \equiv \boxed{8} \pmod{13}$.
